gloss: outskirts of town; edge of town

definitions.gloss: outskirts of town; edge of town
definitions.explanation: The area at the edge of a town where buildings thin out and the countryside begins.

examples.japanese: {町外|まちはず}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live on the outskirts of town.

examples.japanese: {町外|まちはず}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦お{寺|てら}→お寺：23515_otera⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's an old temple on the edge of town.

examples.japanese: ⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{町外|まちはず}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{停留所|ていりゅうじょ}→停留所：03440_teiryuujo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{降|お}ろした→降ろす：01923_orosu⟧。
examples.english: The bus dropped its last passenger at a stop on the outskirts of town.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧ (town) + ⟦{外|はず}れ→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (the far end, the part that falls outside). Refers to the thinly built-up margin of a town.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {町外|まちはず}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live on the outskirts
- {町外|まちはず}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: a house at the edge of town

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧: suburbs — the residential belt around a city; {町外|まちはず}れ is the immediate, less developed edge of a town
